visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark shoulder-length hair and pink eyeshadow faces the camera in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds up a cardboard package of 'Returnity' ear acupuncture patches, pointing at the Korean text on the box. (2) Close-up shots show the internal packaging; a clear plastic sheet holding small silver, crystal, and pearl-like beads with circular adhesive backings. Her manicured hands with long pink nails carefully display each type. (3) The woman leans in closer to the camera, pulling her hair back to reveal her left ear. She points to a diagram on the product box showing specific ear points. (4) She uses her fingers to peel off a patch and applies it to the upper part of her ear ('Shenmen' point), pressing it down firmly while looking into the lens as if it were a mirror. (5) She winces and makes exaggerated facial expressions, indicating pain or sensitivity as she presses the patches. Yellow and white variety-style captions appear on screen. (6) After applying three patches (silver, crystal, and pearl), she shakes her hair down and speaks directly to the camera, smiling and gesturing with her hands towards her ear to show the final aesthetic effect.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female voice introduces the product with moderate arousal. A light, rhythmic acoustic-pop BGM plays at a lower volume. (2) A 'ding' SFX sounds as the price appears. The voice remains casual and narrative. (3) Soft plastic rustling is heard as she handles the product. A 'pop' SFX accompanies the close-up of the beads. (4) The vocal pitch rises as she describes applying the patch. (5) Loud, high-pitched vocalizations ('Ah!') occur when she presses the patch, accompanied by a cartoonish 'shock' SFX. The BGM continues steadily. (6) The voice returns to a calm, friendly summary tone, ending with a cheerful sign-off.
